notes.text:
if someone tells me they've softlocked themselves in CI2 I'm gonna yell
## Info 
* [Information](https://thelx5.github.io/smw/)
* [Setup](https://thelx5.github.io/smw/setup.html)
## Changes
* A ton of [logic updates and tricks](https://github.com/TheLX5/Archipelago/pull/33) courtesy of Frieze
* Enemy shuffle updates
	* Guarantees a colored koopa (or a shell) in several levels
		* YI1, DP4, VD1, VD4, VS1, BB2, COM, FI1, SW5
	* DP4 no longer has undefeatable enemies with a kicked shell where the goomba conga line is
	* COM no longer has undefeatable enemies with a kicked shell where the monty mole zig zag is
	* Larry's fight no longer has a boo block as a valid option to roll into the arena
* Moved last dragon coin on CI2 to be _after_ the goal so people don't softlock themselves
* Removed tile destruction on the overworld, that way Switch Palaces can be entered again even if the location was collected
* Too lazy to update the credits version number
